contract.question: Will Donald Trump win the 2024 US Presidential Election?
contract.rulesSummary: YES if Donald J. Trump wins the 2024 US presidential election; AP, Fox News and NBC must call the same winner, with inauguration as fallback.

dataReadiness.measurement: Hourly YES contract price; descriptive percentage-point response, no causal attribution and no missing-bucket filling.

cards.text: A New York jury finds Donald Trump guilty on 34 felony counts.
cards.whyItMattered: A historic criminal conviction created legal and political downside while also inviting a mobilization response.
cards.caveat: Verdict expectations and courthouse reporting were already moving the contract before the cutoff.

cards.text: Donald Trump survives an assassination attempt at a Pennsylvania rally.
cards.whyItMattered: The shooting changed the campaign's safety, sympathy, convention and turnout narrative immediately.
cards.caveat: The cutoff is the end of a live reporting hour; other campaign developments shared the response window.

cards.text: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. suspends his campaign and endorses Trump.
cards.whyItMattered: A rival presidential campaign joined Trump's coalition, changing the field and potential vote transfer.
cards.caveat: The decision was discussed before the speech; the negative movement is observed, not explained away.

cards.text: Kamala Harris and Donald Trump meet in their first presidential debate.
cards.whyItMattered: The replacement Democratic nominee's first national test could change expectations in a close election.
cards.caveat: The ABC page was later edited; the packet uses the approximate broadcast end and does not backdate later transcript content.

cards.text: A final Iowa poll puts Harris ahead of Trump, 47% to 44%.
cards.whyItMattered: A late state poll contradicted the prevailing Trump narrative and could alter last-minute expectations.
cards.caveat: This is a state poll with a stated margin of error; the delayed window reaches election night and is contaminated by later information.

ending.text: AP called the 2024 presidential race for Trump on November 6, 2024; the contract ultimately resolved YES.
